text: Training objectives This major develops the basic knowledge of electronic technology and information systems, and can engage in advanced engineering and technical personnel for the research, design, manufacture, application and development of all kinds of electronic equipment and information systems.Student mainly studies the acquisition and processing of signal, the information system of power plant equipment and other professional knowledge. It has been trained in the basic practice of electronic and information engineering, and has the ability to design, develop, apply and integrate electronic equipment and information systems.Internship curriculum experiment, computer training, curriculum design, production practice, graduation design, etc. It is generally required that the practice of teaching is not less than 30 weeks.Durationfour yearsDegree Awarded Bachelor of Engineering
